Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activity records in assay CHEMBL1054501. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
